caption: The drawing depicts a doll-like human figure standing in profile facing right. The figure has a light pink skin tone and is unclothed, with visible joint articulations at the shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips, knees, and ankles, resembling a mannequin or ball-jointed doll. The figure has short, curly, light yellow hair held back with a thin, black headband. The eyes, lips, and facial features are finely detailed with a pinkish hue to the cheeks. There are three broad, off-white or light beige fabric bands wrapped around the torso, upper arms, and upper legs, which stand out against the smooth and glossy appearance of the rest of the body. The background is a plain, cream color with no additional objects or elements. The drawing is signed "Eugenio Casas" in small, fine script near the lower right area of the image.
title: Doll - "Adeline"
